title: semrel configuration
description: Configuration schema for semrel — semantic release automation. https://semrel.io

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of this config file. Use `semrel migrate` to upgrade. Currently 1.

branches.description: List of release branches. semrel only creates releases when run on one of these branches.

tagPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to the version number when creating git tags. Default: "v". An empty string disables the prefix. Must not contain whitespace.

rules.description: Mapping of conventional commit types (and optionally scopes) to semver bump levels. Overrides the built-in defaults.

plugins.description: Plugins to run during the release pipeline (conditions, analyzers, generators, updaters, providers, publishers, packagers, hooks).

version_ceiling.description: Maximum version semrel will release. Semver string, e.g. "1.0.0". Releases above this ceiling are handled by ceiling_strategy.

ceiling_strategy.description: What to do when the computed next version exceeds version_ceiling. Default: "clamp".

commit_changelog.description: Whether semrel commits CHANGELOG.md back to the repo before creating the release tag. Default: true.

tag_exists_strategy.description: What to do when the computed tag already exists. Default: "update-changelog".

workspace.description: Enables multi-package workspace (monorepo) mode. Use 'semrel workspace release' to orchestrate all packages. 'packages' and 'pattern' are mutually exclusive.

packages.description: Explicit list of workspace packages. Mutually exclusive with 'pattern'.

path.description: Directory of the package relative to the repository root.

tagPrefix.description: Git tag prefix for this package. Defaults to '<path>@v' in independent mode.

dependsOn.description: Paths of packages this package depends on. Dependencies are released first.

ignorePaths.description: Globs relative to the package root whose changes alone never release the package. Replaces workspace.ignorePaths.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to auto-discover package directories. Mutually exclusive with 'packages'.

fail_fast.description: Stop the workspace release on the first package failure. Default: false (collect all errors).

sharedPaths.description: Repo-level globs (relative to the repository root) that belong to no package. By default commits touching only these release nothing; packages with includeShared count them as their own changes.

includeShared.description: Workspace-wide default: whether commits touching sharedPaths count towards each package.

ignorePaths.description: Globs relative to each package root whose changes alone never release the package. Workspace-wide default; a package's own ignorePaths replace it.

BranchConfig.description: Configuration for a single release branch.

prerelease.description: Pre-release identifier appended to the version (e.g. "beta", "alpha.1"). Omit for stable releases.

maintenance.description: Mark as a maintenance branch — only patch bumps are allowed. Auto-detected for N.x / N.M.x patterns.

ReleaseRule.description: Maps a conventional commit type (and optionally scope) to a semver bump level. Scope can be a string (exact match), false (scopeless commits only), or omitted (any scope).

scope.description: Optional scope filter. When omitted the rule matches commits of this type regardless of scope. When set to a string it matches only commits with that exact scope. When set to false it matches only commits that carry no scope at all.

oneOf.description: false — match only commits with no scope.

bump.description: Semver bump level triggered by this commit type (and scope, if set).

hidden.description: When true, matching commits still affect the version bump but are omitted from generated changelogs and release notes. Breaking changes are always listed.

PluginConfig.description: Configuration for a single semrel plugin.

uses.description: Plugin reference. The canonical form is "@semrel/<category>-<name>" (e.g. "@semrel/provider-github"); the typed name without namespace ("provider-github") and legacy short aliases ("github") are accepted for first-party plugins.

name.description: Local alias for this plugin instance. Useful when the same plugin is used multiple times.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the plugin binary. Use instead of 'uses' for local/custom plugins.

args.description: Plugin-specific arguments passed as key-value pairs. Refer to the plugin's documentation.

phase.description: Pipeline phase in which this plugin runs. "condition" runs before commits are analyzed (gate check); "generator" runs after the changelog is generated and may replace it by printing custom text to stdout; "pre-tag" runs before the tag is created and its file changes are auto-committed; "release" runs after the tag is created. Default: "release".
